name: Breakbot
description: '''Thibaut Jean-Marie Michel Berland''' ({{IPA|fr|tibo ʒɑ̃ maʁi miʃɛl bɛʁlɑ̃}}; born October 5, 1981), known professionally as '''Breakbot''', is a French musician, record producer and a DJ who has been signed with [[Ed Banger Records]] since May 2009. He is best known for his 2011 hit single "[[Baby I'm Yours (Breakbot song)|Baby I'm Yours]]", which went on to become a popular Internet meme.
